name: Computer Graphics
description: Rendering images from 3D scenes: transforms, the GPU pipeline, shading and textures, ray tracing and animation.

nodes.name: Vectors & geometry
nodes.desc: Points, vectors, dot and cross products, lines and planes in 3D.

nodes.name: Transformations
nodes.desc: Translation, rotation and scaling with homogeneous coordinates and composition.

nodes.name: Raster images
nodes.desc: Pixels, framebuffers, resolution and anti-aliasing.

nodes.name: Colour & light
nodes.desc: RGB and colour spaces, gamma, HDR and how we perceive colour.

nodes.name: Rasterisation
nodes.desc: Turning lines and triangles into pixels with barycentric interpolation.

nodes.name: Cameras & projection
nodes.desc: View transforms, perspective and orthographic projection.

nodes.name: The GPU pipeline
nodes.desc: Vertex processing, rasterisation, fragment processing and output merging on the GPU.

nodes.name: Visibility
nodes.desc: Clipping, culling and the z-buffer.

nodes.name: WebGL & OpenGL
nodes.desc: Buffers, shaders programs and draw calls in a graphics API.

nodes.name: Lighting models
nodes.desc: Ambient, diffuse and specular light with Phong and Blinn-Phong.

nodes.name: Shaders
nodes.desc: Writing vertex and fragment shaders for lighting and effects.

nodes.name: Texture mapping
nodes.desc: UV coordinates, mipmapping, filtering and normal maps.

nodes.name: Shadows
nodes.desc: Shadow mapping and its artefacts.

nodes.name: Real-time renderer
nodes.desc: Build a renderer that loads meshes and draws lit, textured, shadowed scenes.

nodes.name: Ray casting
nodes.desc: Generating rays and intersecting them with spheres, planes and triangles.

nodes.name: BVHs & grids
nodes.desc: Acceleration structures that make ray tracing fast.

nodes.name: Path tracing
nodes.desc: The rendering equation and Monte Carlo light transport.

nodes.name: PBR materials
nodes.desc: Physically based materials, microfacets and energy conservation.

nodes.name: Ray tracer
nodes.desc: Write a path tracer that renders global illumination scenes.

nodes.name: Curves & surfaces
nodes.desc: Bezier curves, B-splines and subdivision surfaces.

nodes.name: Mesh processing
nodes.desc: Mesh data structures, normals, simplification and smoothing.

nodes.name: Animation
nodes.desc: Keyframes, interpolation, quaternions and skeletal skinning.

nodes.name: Simulation
nodes.desc: Particles, cloth and rigid bodies with numerical integration.
